_doc: Size + comment ratchet. New files must stay under maxNewFileLines. Listed files must not grow. Comment share per directory must not rise. Lower these numbers as the refactor lands; never raise one without a note in 'exceptions'. Zig convention: inline `test { }` blocks are idiomatic and not penalised, so 'files' records PRODUCTION lines (everything before the first column-0 `test "` / `test {`), and maxNewFileLines applies to that count; 'commentPct' is over TOTAL lines.

_notes.cli/src/console commentPct 14 -> 15: Phase 6 moved ~4,600 lines of comment-sparse implementation out of cli/src/console into console/{handlers,llm,screen,session}/ (each newly pinned at its own measured share). The directory's ABSOLUTE comment count fell from ~1289 to 640; only the denominator moved. No comment was added to the files that stayed.
